findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employees was observed bare-handling a waffle ice cream cone while inspector was present. The waffle cone ice cream was discarded. And education was provided. Ensure that employees are knowledgeable to avoid contaminating ready eat food items with their bare hands.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: An employee hand-bag was observed on the condiments’ counter in the chill area by the ice cream machine. Education was provided. The bag was removed and the surface was cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that employees are aware to put their personal belongings in the designated areas provided at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-305.11 Designation. (A) Dressing rooms or dressing areas shall be designated if EMPLOYEES routinely change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be provided for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEES' clothing and other possessions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: An accumulation of food debris was observed in the handwashing sink next to the grill in the kitchen. Education was provided. Ensure that all handwashing sinks within the facility are used only for the sole purpose of handwashing at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The concentration of the sanitizer in the sanitizer buckets was reading between 100-0 ppm. Discussed with the PIC. The buckets were remade. Ensure that the concentration of all sanitizers are measured within the appropriate range.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: An accumulation of soil was observed on the nozzles of the soda machine in the lobby area. The PIC was made aware. The nozzles were removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ones mentioned are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed employee storing wet wiping cloth on a counter surface without it being held in a sanitizer solution. Education was provided and the behavior was abolished. Ensure that wet wiping cloths in-use are kept within a sanitizer solution at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a plumbing leak in the lines beneath the three compartment sink in the chill area by the ice cream machines. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the necessary repairs are done according to the LAW.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Multiple mop heads were observed not stored properly. Discussed with PIC. The mop heads were removed to be stored properly. Ensure that the mop heads are always stored in a position that allows them to air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: An accumulation of ice and frost was observed on the fan hood of the standing freezer by the first drive-thru window. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspector that the ice will be cleaned. Ensure that the ice is cleaned providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrie to shut the faucet after washing their hands. PIC was made aware of the observed behavior. The appropriate correction was made. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable on proper handwashing etiquette.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a plumbing leak in the lines beneath the three compartment sink in the chill station where the ice cream machines are the lines under the dump sink in the back. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the necessary repairs are done according to the LAW.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Multiple mop heads were observed not stored properly. Discussed with PIC. The mop heads were removed to be stored properly. Ensure that the mop heads are always stored in a position that allows them to air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed staff donning gloves without washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and the behavior as corrected.
Ensure that staff area knowledgeable about washing their hands before donning gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (1) Rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) Apply an amount of cleaning compound recommended by the cleaning compound manufacturer; (3) Rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds while: (a) Paying particular attention to removing soil from underneath the fingernails during the cleaning procedure, and (b) Creating friction on the surfaces of the hands and arms or surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms, finger tips, and areas between the fingers; (4) Thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrie to shut the faucet after washing their hands. PIC was made aware of the observed behavior and the appropriate correction was made. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable on proper handwashing etiquette.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observe a few live flies in the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensure inspector that the adequate actions will be taken. Ensure that the facility is free of insects or other pest to eliminate harborage.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The facility is observed to have a down ice machine being store in the back by the first drive-through windows. Discussed with PIC and PIC told inspector that they had previously put in for the repairs of  the Ice machine in question. However, they were told by management that they will get a new one soon. Ensure that this equipment is remove from the facility if it is not being used or if there are no plans in motion to get it repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: There is observed an ice cream cake in the cake prep freezer that was uncovered directly under the fan unit that has ice accumulation. This ice accumulation had caused contamination on the cake that was uncovered. PIC discarded the cake during the inspection. Ensure that food items are protected form contamination during storage, preparation, and display. 
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: At the start of the inspection, there was no santiizer bucket available for use. PIC corrected this violation by utilizing the automatic dispenser available and making a sanitizer bucket for use. Ensure that a sanitizer bucket is readily available during all hours of operation. 
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The single sink to the left of the back room triple sink is observed a sink faucet that has become detached from the sink structure. When tuned on, the faucet is able to fall off while in use. Ensure this faucet is repaired and maintained in good repair. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The following areas are observed to be in need of fresh caulking:
-The triple sink in the back
-Both hand sinks
-The triple sink near the cake decorating
Ensure these surfaces receive caulking to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface that eliminates the gap between the equipment and the wall. This is a repeat violation from the original inspection that took place on 6/21/2023 and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violations. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following locations are in need of detailed cleaning to remove dirt/debris and other soils:
-Floor of the walk-in freezer, especially under the stored items
-Floor under the dry storage shelves 
Ensure these surfaces become part of the routine cleaning procedures to maintain the physical facilities clean.
This is a repeat violation from the original inspection that took place on 6/21/2023 and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violations. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: The facility is observed to have a down prep cooler along the cook line that has not been in use for a few years and does not have a plan to get repaired at this time and is observed with food/soil debris. This piece of equipment needs to be repaired or removed from the facility or kept clean if it is to remain in the facility. This is a repeat violation from the original inspection that took place on 6/21/2023 and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violations.
